# CreateUDPStream <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CreateUDPStream:Int32 port:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `port` | In | Int32 | `0` | The port to receive on. Defaults to 0, which lets the system pick one. |

**Returns:** A UDP stream, or 0 when the port cannot be used.

## Description

Creates a UDP stream that can send and receive messages. Use a fixed port when other programs have to find you, and no port to let the system pick one.

## Differences

* The stream receives IPv4 and IPv6 messages (where the system has IPv6), see [IPv6](IPv6).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
a = CreateUDPStream(40752)
b = CreateUDPStream(40753)
UDPTimeouts 1000
WriteInt a, 12345
SendUDPMsg a, $7F000001, 40753
size = RecvUDPMsg(b)
Print size
Print ReadInt(b)
Print UDPMsgPort(b)
CloseUDPStream a
CloseUDPStream b
```

```text
4
12345
40752
```
